faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for HNBGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in HNBGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Guest Faculty.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for HNBGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 18 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 35,000/ for Ph.D./NET holder or applicable as per University rules.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Good academic record with at least 55% marks at the Master Degree (Medicinal and Aromatic Plants/Plant Physiology/Botany/Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Phytochemistry) level and other essential qualifications as laid down by the UGC from time to time. A relaxation of 5% (55% to 50%) may be provided for SC/ST/PH.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Qualifications/experiences as on the last date of submission of applications only will be considered.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Incomplete applications or applications without relevant supporting enclosures will be out-rightly rejected. Application not signed by the candidate is liable to be rejected.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. Engagement through walk-in interview in the Office of Dean of School at Chauras Campus, 21-11-2026, 10.30 AM onwards.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement for the academic session 2026-27 on 44 days basis or till the regular incumbent joins the post, whichever is earlier. University may at any time withdraw the offer of engagement to the Guest Faculty.

faq.answer: High Altitude Plant Physiology Research Centre (HAPPRC), HNB Garhwal University, Srinagar (Garhwal), Uttarakhand.
